svg.title: Pair model of trcm_pairs: emitter and receiver columns

g.inkscape:label: Titles and notes
g.text: trcm_pairs: emitter and receiver TRCM columns with vertical ground conduction
borehole interior (fluid, pipes, grout and core, as in one layer): radial only, no vertical conduction
vertical soil conduction ks·A/Δz between nodes of the same radius in adjacent layers (Tb and the soil core included)
one-way coupling: emitter ground at r = d (ln r interpolation, same layer) acts on the receiver
interior through the edges reaching its wall node; the receiver soil nodes carry its own disturbance
Surface, bottom and r = rs held at 0 in every column; node capacities not drawn; one receiver column per distance d.
